blocks.tamil_translation: believing in Him)? He brings forth the light of daybreak (from the darkness of night). He made the night for rest, and the sun and the moon as a reckoning (of time). This is the decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing. And He is the One who made the stars for you, so that by them you may find the right way in the darkness of land and sea. We have certainly explained (Our) verses in detail for a people who know. And He is the One who created you from a single soul; then there is (for you) a place of lodging (in the mother's womb) and a place of deposit (in your father). We have certainly explained (Our) verses in detail for a people who understand. And He is the One who sends down rain from the sky. Then by it We bring forth vegetation of every kind; and from it We bring forth green growth, and from that We bring forth grain piled in layers; and from the date-palm, from its spathe, there are clusters (of fruit) hanging (low); and (by that water We bring forth) gardens of grapes, and olives and pomegranates, alike (in appearance) and different (in taste). Look at its fruit when it bears fruit, and (then) at its ripening. Indeed in this there are clear signs for a people who believe (in the One God).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَلِلّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَرَبِّ اْلاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِينَ۞ وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَآءُ فيِ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ ؕ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ۞).
